kind: Separate retrospective evidence checks and prospective re-verification contract; prior results already known, not a new scientific preregistration.
purpose: Diagnose unresolved choice episodes before goal scaling
capacity_sweep_extension: Not started or authorized by this registration. Existing later studies are distinct evidence, not a repair of Test 3.
neither_handling: Retain all unresolved trials in unconditional denominators; no preferred-goal assignment, no latent weight from non-reach.
original_weights: Retain original censoring/unidentified flags; no estimator replacement.

checks.title: Greedy-policy cycles: separate diagnostic check
checks.scope: Re-verify whether unresolved original greedy episodes have a closed, endpoint-free cycle. A diagnostic explanation, not a competence pass.
checks.action_rule: Original greedy argmax, first-index tie break; original room, fixed proxy, wall consumes step, first endpoint terminates.
checks.cohort: All 16 frozen Test 3 policies and all original/reflected/distance-reweighted primary trials; all 80 archived battery arrays remain integrity prerequisites. No seed or episode exclusion.
checks.gate: Replay all saved paths/actions against direct neural inference and reconstruct closed cycle states; exactly account for every unresolved episode. Report unclassified cases if any; do not force them into a cycle or goal label.
checks.inference: Exact finite evidence verification; no new population inference.

checks.title: Rollout horizon: separate diagnostic check
checks.scope: Check whether extending only the greedy cutoff from 20 to 40 or 80 changes endpoint outcomes on identical starts/policies.
checks.action_rule: Same original greedy rule and simulator; common saved trajectory prefixes. No sampling, retries, masks or resets in this check.
checks.cohort: Same all-policy/all-primary-trial cohort as cycle check.
checks.gate: Independently verify prefix identity and all unconditional gem/proxy/neither outcomes at 20/40/80. Count non-reach rescues and endpoint switches. A horizon comparison is a sensitivity check; it cannot replace Test 3’s 20-step result.
checks.inference: Known prior results are re-verified; not an untouched confirmation set.

checks.title: Task competence: separate diagnostic check
checks.scope: Preserve Test 3’s existing endpoint-competence gate before interpreting goals. Reached endpoints must be separated from intended-goal success.
checks.action_rule: Primary: original greedy policy and 20-step horizon. Secondary: independently specified categorical-softmax-v1 deployment contract, kept separate.
checks.cohort: Primary: 16 Test 3 policies, eight seeds per entropy cohort, three same-task batteries. Secondary: same policies on previously reserved 315 initial pairs, 56 equal-distance pairs; this reserve is now exhausted.
checks.gate: Original competence requirement unchanged: mean equal-distance neither ≤0.10 in both batteries of each registered original primary comparison, plus original calibration. Report every battery/cohort; a failed battery blocks its goal interpretation. Secondary deployment gate remains all four one-sided Bonferroni 98.75% upper t bounds on neither ≤0.10 (two cohorts × all/equal-distance); no goal-recovery claim.
checks.inference: A secondary categorical pass cannot repair original greedy failures. Neither a pass nor proxy completion authorizes scaling or identifies an aligned goal.
